title: Early-stage startup outcome priors
population: Pre-seed to seed-stage software startups (exploratory reference, not personalized VC calibration)
definition: Mutually exclusive outcome buckets for multi_outcome startup path goals. Weights shift with observed revenue, runway, and fundraising signals but never from LLM intuition.
limitations: Not calibrated to a specific founder, market, or vintage year.
Geography and sector are not modeled unless future reference artifacts add them.
No latent startup-quality score is produced.
permitted_use: multi_outcome baseline pricing and Possible Futures weight authority when evidence is sparse

claims.claim: Outcome weights are frozen exploratory priors adjusted only by typed evidence signals.
